title: Hand Cranked Generator
keywords: Manual FE source for starting or testing a small workshop

blocks.text: Manual FE source for starting or testing a small workshop.

rows: Place the generator and use its crank interaction.
Connect a permitted energy output to your first buffer or machine.
Repeat until the full intended process batch is funded.

blocks.text: A large late-game recipe can require far more FE than repeated cranking is convenient for. The server can change energy per use.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
